person.name: Yitbarek Tegene
person.title: AI-native builder; Co-Founder, Eiqora Technologies
person.how_i_work: Hand-written coding fluency is Python basics. All projects were built by directing AI development tools (Claude Code, Cursor) through specifications, phase plans and reviews. Specializes in identifying and fixing defects in AI-generated applications and content until they are production-ready, verified with benchmarks, build logs and regression tests.

projects.name: Eiqora Technologies
projects.summary: Software studio and platform that builds bespoke, per-client apps for masjids, schools, NGOs and agencies, each with its own Postgres schema and design system inside one Next.js monorepo, then hands them over to client staff.

projects.name: BIC Masjid Platform
projects.summary: Full masjid platform for the Bangladesh Islamic Center: member community app with membership billing and programs, a madrasa LMS with an append-only Hifz ledger, quizzes and report cards, and an imam console for moderation and communications.

projects.name: Darul Amal
projects.summary: Four-portal operations platform for an Ethiopian foreign-employment agency: staff pipeline with 12 case stages and finance, Arabic-first RTL employer portal, worker PWA with PIN login, broker field tool. WhatsApp Business API and Claude translation.

projects.name: Nejashi / Sakina
projects.summary: Multi-tenant SaaS for mosques in Ethiopia: marketing site, operator console, imam console and Amharic-first member app in one pnpm/Turborepo monorepo on Neon Postgres with RLS, append-only ledgers guarded by triggers, and migrations gated on deploy.

projects.name: Dar Al Safar
projects.summary: Public website and internal operations command center for a luxury travel and concierge agency: CRM with document vault, GDS-style ticketing with PNR expiry, drag-and-drop visa pipeline, cash log to verified ledger, ETB payroll, investor reports, command palette.

projects.name: Multitenant Platform
projects.summary: Business-agnostic multi-tenant SaaS foundation. Tenant isolation enforced by forced Postgres row-level security with no superuser or bypass; billing and entitlement snapshots from verified Stripe webhooks; transactional outbox with exactly-once inbox; quarantine-first file storage; offboarding state machine; support impersonation with database-enforced dual control; hash-chained audit ledger; pure-Node TOTP and WebAuthn; Next.js operator console.

projects.name: Offline Survival LLM
projects.summary: Fully offline survival-reference device: Raspberry Pi 5 running Qwen2.5-3B on llama.cpp with hybrid FAISS + BM25 retrieval over 15 public-domain manuals; Arduino UNO keypad and LCD multi-tap input; critical mode prints verbatim sources at temperature zero. Every session, benchmark and mistake is logged.

projects.name: Pip desktop agent
projects.summary: macOS desktop pet whose brain is Claude Code running headless on the user's own subscription. Transparent click-through overlay, streaming speech bubble, Allow/Deny cards before any change, secrets off-limits, scheduled chores with quiet hours.

projects.name: Quran Hifz Trainer
projects.summary: Offline-first PWA for Quran memorization with a custom spaced-repetition engine modelled on sabaq, sabqi and manzil loops, a drill ladder from listen to blind recall, real Madinah Mushaf page rendering, and full on-device data custody with export and rollback.

projects.name: Sovereign Architect
projects.summary: Local-first deterministic life planner: critical-path scheduling, five-capital monthly simulation, Pareto exploration of orderings, Monte Carlo risk trials. Pure TypeScript engine with no DOM or unseeded randomness.

projects.name: Telegram Channel Scraper
projects.summary: Free local tool with a web UI that archives public Telegram channel history to JSON and CSV incrementally through the official API. MIT licensed.

projects.name: Eman
projects.summary: Personal project command center: phases, issues, ideas, time logs and costs with a sub-20-second quick-log path and AES-256 encrypted secure notes.
